one_shot.refusal_order: existing-result check runs BEFORE the flag check and BEFORE any network access

windows.note: windows are defined on AS-OF dates and partition the date line exactly; outcome observation dates may fall after the boundary for development observations, per the registration

input_snapshot.acquisition: live SODA pull at run time, inspection grain, same query the development diagnostics used
input_snapshot.hash: sha256 over the UNCOMPRESSED canonical JSON rows, recorded in the result

output_schema.registration_commit: string, must equal this file's registration_commit
output_schema.protocol_sha256: sha256 of this file at run time
output_schema.levels: per level: n, failures, failure_rate, wilson_lo, wilson_hi, censored
output_schema.strata: same fields per reason code, unconfirmed never folded into confirmed
output_schema.verdict: monotonic: bool, separation_pp: number, min_n_met: bool, h1: pass|fail|inconclusive
output_schema.opened_at_utc: timestamp of the one authorized opening

verdict_rules_source: irc_prereg.json#hypothesis_h1 - not restated here, one source only
on_inconclusive: new methodology version against a later window; this window is spent either way
